=== SDK Example 11: Multi-Signature Types (C#) ===

Endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:51332

--- Step 1: List All Signature Types ---

  UNKNOWN = 0 (wire: "unknown")
  LEGACY_ED25519 = 1 (wire: "legacyED25519")
  ED25519 = 2 (wire: "ed25519")
  RCD1 = 3 (wire: "rcd1")
  BTC = 4 (wire: "btc")
  BTC_LEGACY = 5 (wire: "btcLegacy")
  ETH = 6 (wire: "eth")
  DELEGATED = 7 (wire: "delegated")
  INTERNAL = 8 (wire: "internal")
  RSA_SHA256 = 9 (wire: "rsaSha256")
  ECDSA_SHA256 = 10 (wire: "ecdsaSha256")
  TYPED_DATA = 11 (wire: "typedData")
  REMOTE = 12 (wire: "remote")
  RECEIPT = 13 (wire: "receipt")
  PARTITION = 14 (wire: "partition")
  SET = 15 (wire: "set")
  AUTHORITY = 16 (wire: "authority")

--- Step 2: Wire Name Lookup ---

  "ed25519" -> ED25519 (value=2)
  "rcd1" -> RCD1 (value=3)
  "btc" -> BTC (value=4)
  "eth" -> ETH (value=6)
  "delegated" -> DELEGATED (value=7)
  "rsaSha256" -> RSA_SHA256 (value=9)

Lite Token Account: acc://92cbceb5a0052874bbea3cc0b456ad2dea8bb2ad9e88c60b/acme
